# Introduction

Figure 3B: paired violin-box plots for the top NanoString biomarkers identified
by Random Forest. Each panel shows one stimulation-gene combination. Paired
Wilcoxon signed-rank test comparing W0 to W16, with FDR correction applied
across all biomarkers tested.

# Load packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file  <- "Input/Nanostring_Wide_log2_normalised.xlsx"
output_fig3b <- "Output/03. Figure_3B"

dir.create(output_fig3b, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter and recode

```{r}
nano_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "TB",   "Mtb_Ag", Stimulation),
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "NULL", "Null",   Stimulation),
    Visit       = paste0("W", Visit)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Barcode %in% "0408230288") %>%
  select(-Barcode)

cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Columns: %d\n", nrow(nano_data), ncol(nano_data)))
cat(sprintf("Visits: %s\n",       paste(unique(nano_data$Visit),       collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Stimulations: %s\n", paste(unique(nano_data$Stimulation), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Data overview

```{r}
plot_intro(nano_data)
```

# Define biomarkers to plot

```{r}
biomarkers <- data.frame(
  Stimulation = c("LPS",    "LPS",   "LPS",    "Mtb_Ag",    "Mtb_Ag"),
  Gene        = c("NLRP3", "LIF",   "TLR7",   "CD79B", "IL1RN"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

biomarkers
```

# Paired Wilcoxon test function

For each stimulation-gene combination, donors with measurements at both W0 and
W16 are paired by Donor ID. FDR correction is applied across all biomarkers
after all tests are run.

```{r}
run_wilcox_nano <- function(data, biomarkers) {

  results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(biomarkers)), function(i) {
    stim <- biomarkers$Stimulation[i]
    gene <- biomarkers$Gene[i]

    stim_data <- data %>%
      filter(Stimulation == stim, Visit %in% c("W0", "W16")) %>%
      select(Donor, Visit, Value = all_of(gene)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Value))

    w0_data  <- stim_data %>% filter(Visit == "W0")
    w16_data <- stim_data %>% filter(Visit == "W16")

    paired_donors <- intersect(w0_data$Donor, w16_data$Donor)

    if (length(paired_donors) < 3) {
      cat(sprintf("Skipping %s_%s: fewer than 3 paired donors\n", stim, gene))
      return(NULL)
    }

    v0  <- w0_data$Value[match(paired_donors,  w0_data$Donor)]
    v16 <- w16_data$Value[match(paired_donors, w16_data$Donor)]

    test <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(v16, v0, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(test)) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      Stimulation = stim,
      Gene        = gene,
      Label       = paste0(stim, "_", gene),
      N_pairs     = length(paired_donors),
      Median_W0   = round(median(v0), 3),
      Median_W16  = round(median(v16), 3),
      Log2FC      = round(median(v16) - median(v0), 3),
      P_value     = test$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P_value, method = "fdr"))
}
```

# Run tests and save results

```{r}
wilcox_results <- run_wilcox_nano(nano_data, biomarkers)

print(wilcox_results)

write_xlsx(wilcox_results, file.path(output_fig3b, "Wilcoxon_results_Fig3B.xlsx"))
```

# Violin plot function

Each plot shows the distribution at W0 and W16 as a violin with an overlaid
boxplot. Gray lines connect paired measurements from the same donor. The
FDR-adjusted p-value is annotated above a bracket.

```{r}
plot_violin <- function(data, stimulation, gene, p_adj,
                        save_path   = NULL,
                        plot_width  = 4,
                        plot_height = 5) {

  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(Stimulation == stimulation, Visit %in% c("W0", "W16")) %>%
    select(Donor, Visit, Value = all_of(gene)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    mutate(Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W16")))

  paired_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Donor) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_label <- if (is.na(p_adj)) {
    "FDR = NA"
  } else if (p_adj < 0.001) {
    "FDR < 0.001"
  } else {
    paste0("FDR = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_adj))
  }

  y_range <- range(plot_data$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_seg   <- y_range[2] + 0.08 * diff(y_range)
  y_ann   <- y_range[2] + 0.16 * diff(y_range)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit, y = Value, fill = Visit)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_line(
      data = paired_data,
      aes(group = Donor),
      color = "gray40", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_seg, yend = y_seg,
             linewidth = 0.4, color = "white") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_ann, label = p_label, size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("W0" = "#FF3300", "W16" = "#3399FF"),
      guide  = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(gene, " | ", stimulation),
      subtitle = "Paired Wilcoxon test, FDR adjusted | W0 vs W16",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "NanoString counts (log2)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        save_path,
        paste0(stimulation, "_", gene, "_violin.png")
      ),
      plot   = p,
      width  = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      units  = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Figure 3B: Generate plots

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(biomarkers))) {
  stim <- biomarkers$Stimulation[i]
  gene <- biomarkers$Gene[i]

  p_adj <- wilcox_results$P_adj[
    wilcox_results$Stimulation == stim & wilcox_results$Gene == gene
  ]

  if (length(p_adj) == 0) p_adj <- NA

  plot_violin(
    data        = nano_data,
    stimulation = stim,
    gene        = gene,
    p_adj       = p_adj,
    save_path   = output_fig3b
  )
}
```
